exposure: multifetal gestation conceived through in vitro fertilization (IVF)
cohort: 90,552 multifetal gestations conceived spontaneously and 3219 IVF conceptions from the HCUP-NIS database (2008-2014)
finding: Multifetal pregnancies conceived through IVF were associated with increased risks of various pregnancy, delivery, and neonatal complications compared to spontaneously conceived multifetal pregnancies.
mod_finding: IVF multifetal gestations were associated with an increased risk of cesarean section compared to spontaneously conceived multifetal pregnancies (aOR 1.21, 95 % CI 1.10-1.33).
